# `b10x-loom-operator`

Generated from the clap definition of the `b10x-loom-operator` command line in [`crates/loom-operator/src/cli.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/loom/blob/main/crates/loom-operator/src/cli.rs) by `loom-docs`. It lists only commands that exist.

> The Kubernetes controller of the LoomAgent resource: each resource runs as one checked agent pod

`b10x-loom-operator --version` prints its version, and `--help` after any command prints the text below.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`b10x-loom-operator run`](#b10x-loom-operator-run) | Watch the LoomAgent resources of the configured namespace and reconcile each into its ServiceAccount, ConfigMap, Deployment (a Job for a command), NetworkPolicy and Service, publishing its lifecycle as its status |
| [`b10x-loom-operator render`](#b10x-loom-operator-render) | Print the children of one LoomAgent document as one multi-document YAML, after the checks the controller runs. Nothing is applied and no cluster is read |
| [`b10x-loom-operator crd`](#b10x-loom-operator-crd) | Print the LoomAgent CustomResourceDefinition, the bytes of deploy/crd/loomagents.loom.beyond10x.dev.yaml |

## `b10x-loom-operator run`

Watch the LoomAgent resources of the configured namespace and reconcile each into its ServiceAccount, ConfigMap, Deployment (a Job for a command), NetworkPolicy and Service, publishing its lifecycle as its status

```text
Usage: b10x-loom-operator run --config <FILE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config <FILE>` | yes | none | The controller's configuration, YAML: namespace, defaultImage, defaultResources, modelRoute, allowedSecretNames, allowedEgressHosts, allowedClaimNames |

```text
The configuration names the one namespace watched, the default agent image and resources, the
model route a resource with empty routes is given, and the Secret names and egress hosts a resource
may use. The cluster is the in-cluster service account's, else the current kubeconfig context's.
Each resource is checked in-process before any child exists; a refused one has no children and its
status names the refusal. The record of the resources lives in memory: after a restart every
resource is checked again and its status rewritten.

Exit status:
  0  the watch ended on a signal
  1  the configuration, the plugin catalog or the cluster connection cannot be read
  2  the command line is not valid
```

## `b10x-loom-operator render`

Print the children of one LoomAgent document as one multi-document YAML, after the checks the controller runs. Nothing is applied and no cluster is read

```text
Usage: b10x-loom-operator render [OPTIONS] --resource <FILE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--resource <FILE>` | yes | none | One LoomAgent document, YAML or JSON |
| `--config <FILE>` | no | none | The controller's configuration, as run reads it; the built-in one without it |

```text
The resource's namespace is its metadata.namespace, else the configuration's. Without --config the
built-in configuration applies: namespace default, the agent image registry.example/loom-agent at
this version, 250m CPU and 256Mi memory, no model route, and no Secret name or egress host admitted.
The children carry the resource as owner only when the document has a metadata.uid.

Exit status:
  0  the children, as one multi-document YAML on standard output
  3  refused: standard error carries "refused: <reason> at <member>: <detail>"
  1  a file cannot be read, or the plugin catalog cannot be loaded
  2  the command line is not valid, or the document is not a LoomAgent
```

## `b10x-loom-operator crd`

Print the LoomAgent CustomResourceDefinition, the bytes of deploy/crd/loomagents.loom.beyond10x.dev.yaml

```text
Usage: b10x-loom-operator crd
```
